snippet.title: Crime Daily Dose
snippet.description:
Welcome to Crime Daily Dose.
We're dedicated to unraveling the mysteries of true crime. This is the perfect place to get your true crime fix! 

Each episode delves deep into the dark and complex world of criminal cases, ranging from unsolved mysteries to infamous trials. The channel offers a daily dose of intriguing content, featuring expertly researched narratives, interviews with investigators, psychological analyses, and reenactments. It provides an immersive experience for true crime enthusiasts, blending factual reporting with compelling storytelling. 

The channel maintains a respectful and sensitive approach towards victims and their families while offering viewers a detailed look into the criminal mind and the justice system. With its gripping content and dedicated following, "Crime Daily Dose" is a go-to destination for those fascinated by the darker side of humanity.

If you don't want to miss any of our content, make sure to SUBSCRIBE.

Videos published weekly!

snippet.title: American Scam Stories
snippet.description:
📋 AMERICAN SCAM STORIES

Welcome to American Scam Stories! On this channel, you'll find both real and fictional stories of financial fraud that expose betrayal and deception.

We create our real cases from court records, while our fictional stories are inspired by true events. Our goal is to protect you and your loved ones from falling victim to similar scams by showing how these fraudulent methods work.

Our content is for educational purposes, and fictional stories are clearly labeled in the videos.

Don't forget to subscribe and turn on notifications for a new story every day!

snippet.title: Fireball
snippet.description:
For five years, I filmed a billion-dollar company from the inside. Corporate videos. Holiday parties. NASCAR sponsorships. I thought I was documenting a success story.

Then the FBI raided them.

I'm Steve Beal. From 2014-2018, I was DC Solar's videographer, capturing everything - including footage that's never been seen outside of federal court. FIREBALL is the documentary series I'm making from thousands of hours of material and over 70 interviews.

Netflix called. HBO called. Many others called. I said no. I wanted to tell this story directly - the right way, on this platform, without leaving anything out.

Episode 1 premieres December 18, 2025 - exactly seven years after the raid.

Subscribe now.

snippet.title: Patrick Boyle
snippet.description:
Patrick Boyle is a hedge fund manager, a university professor and a former investment banker. 

This channel is all about quantitative finance. By subscribing you will see videos explaining what is happening in markets right now, you will learn about financial derivatives, corporate finance and how traders use quantitative tools like statistics. You will see interviews with some of the most interesting people in the financial industry.  In addition, you will see some longer form documentaries on the history of financial markets.

To contact Patrick go to the website http://onfinance.org

DISCLAIMER:
This channel is not affiliated with any financial institution. The videos on this channel are for entertainment purposes only and do not constitute financial advice. Those seeking investment advice should seek out a registered professional. Patrick is not responsible for investment actions taken by viewers and his content should not be used as a basis for investment.

snippet.title: 15 Minutes to the Crime
snippet.description:
Welcome to 15 Minutes to the Crime — your destination for gripping true crime documentaries.

We break down real crime stories, mysteries, scandals, and criminal investigations from around the world — with each episode exploring the critical moments before and after the crime. 

From unsolved disappearances and cold cases to famous heists, serial killers, and crimes of passion, our videos bring true crime to life with cinematic storytelling and accurate detail.

Whether you’re into:
	•	Shocking true crime cases
	•	Famous unsolved mysteries
	•	High-profile robberies and heists
	•	Chilling murders and psychological breakdowns
	•	Or just love a good crime countdown story…

You’ve come to the right place.

Posted every Monday, Wednesday & Friday. 
Subscribe and turn on notifications! 

#TrueCrime #CrimeDocumentary #UnsolvedMysteries #CriminalCases #15MinutesToTheCrime
